mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate investment and consumption, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following low FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates labor market weakness, which may lead to negative economic growth and thus negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following a UNRATE increase, the hypothesis is rejected.
